name: dev_command_contract
definition: canonical invokable command discovered under dev/. commands are the alias-driven subset used by legend, index, and dashboard views.

required.path: string; unique repo-relative declaration path, typically source-path#alias
required.alias: string; canonical invocation token shown in human-facing views
required.name: string; human-facing label

optional.group: string|null; local subgroup retained for non-legend views

rules: commands are the invokable subset of discovered records
alias is required for human-facing command views
path is the authoritative unique command identifier
source_path points at the backing file when one exists
not every component is a command
